sentence: Driven by a sense of internal congestion and bursting, Vipera is engaged in a continuous battle between the need to release pressure and the fear of dissolution, alternating between violent inflammatory states and collapse.
references: Herscu, P. ND DHANP. 'The Cycle of Vipera.' New England Journal of Homeopathy, Vol 7 #1.
Herscu, P. & Rothenberg, A. NESH curriculum materials.

segments.name: Congestion and fullness
segments.description: Profound sense of internal pressure, vessels engorged, feeling of bursting. Varicose veins, hemorrhoids, throbbing pain. Head feels full.

segments.name: Intense burning and inflammation
segments.description: The congestion ignites into burning pain, inflammatory states, fever. Skin burns, mucous membranes inflamed. Violent burning pains with redness.

segments.name: Fear of bursting and hemorrhage
segments.description: Fear that the congestion will lead to rupture, hemorrhage, or death. Anxiety about internal bleeding, blood vessels breaking. Terror of dissolution.

segments.name: Collapse and weakness
segments.description: After the inflammatory peak, sudden prostration, faintness, cold sweat. Pulse weak, skin cold, vitality drained. Desire to lie down, cannot sit up.

segments.name: Icy coldness and numbness
segments.description: Extreme coldness, limbs icy, loss of sensation. Numbness, tingling, paralysis of parts. Skin blue, cyanotic. As if life force withdraws.
